subject: 2028 Summer intern pipeline — HC release & comp band uplift request
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: 2028 Summer intern pipeline — request for +HC and comp band uplift

Team,

Quick summary: after the March campus cycle and a focused follow-up with returning interns, our recruiting team has identified three high-priority intern candidates we want to convert into paid summer interns with offers this cycle. Two are returning interns (high signal) and one is a standout hire from the West Coast career fair.

As things stand, we only have 8 final HC slots in the current campus headcount allocation. I am requesting: 
- Release of +3 short‑term internship headcount for Summer 2028 (term-limited through Aug 31, 2028).
- A temporary uplift to the intern pay band for these specific offers: move from Band I midpoint to Band II entry (approx +12% stipend) to keep the packages competitive in the Bay Area.

Business justification (brief):
- Two are returning interns with direct product-impact work (Llama infra & inference tooling) — conversion increases velocity and reduces ramp time.
- The external candidate brings a rare infra+systems background; hiring at the higher band saves 4–6 weeks of onboarding time vs. a more junior hire.
- Overall projected value: earlier delivery on the streaming cache project + candidate retention into new-grad funnel.

I've attached a candidate_shortlist.csv and a band_uplift_proposal.xlsx with cost delta and budget codes. If we can approve provisional HC + uplift today, Neha will lock offers and we target sending formal letters by EOD tomorrow.

Requesting: Laura — do we have budget headroom under the campus recruiting pool for +3 interns at the uplifted band? Aditya/Neha — please confirm the candidate IDs and any priority ranking. Marissa — if you see operational concerns, flag them and I’ll pull back.

Thanks,
Vivek
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: 2028 Summer intern pipeline — request for +HC and comp band uplift

Vivek — thanks for the overview. I reviewed the attachment briefly. Two quick asks before I can sign off on headcount release:

1) Please confirm budget code (worktag) for the uplifted stipends — band_uplift_proposal.xlsx lists the delta but not the chargeback code. We need the cost to be assigned to an existing campus recruiting pool or an approved project code.
2) Provide the projected P&L impact (total incremental cost for the 3 interns, inclusive of benefits/paid taxes) for Apr–Aug. If the uplift pushes us over the recruiting pool, we can consider a partial offset from central hiring contingency but I need the numbers.

If we have a clean bucket, I'm prepared to approve a provisional +2 HC release now and the +1 conditional on the P&L reconciliation. Provisional approvals will let you start verbal offers.

Also note: anything over Band II entry requires an executive approval memo (rare for interns) — so keep the uplift within Band II entry or we'll need a short justification memo to GC.

Laura
Sr. Director, Finance & People Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 11:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: 2028 Summer intern pipeline — request for +HC and comp band uplift

Thanks Laura — attaching the full spreadsheet with cost roll-up and the candidate_shortlist.csv (attached). Key callouts inline: 

- Budget code: CAMPUS-2028-RECRUIT (we have ~ $38k remaining as of Apr 1). The uplifted delta for 3 interns across Apr–Aug is $18,750 (line items in tab "cost_delta").
- Candidate short descriptions: 
  1) Alex Zhao — returning infra intern (2027). Strong in KV cache work; would be on inference infra team. Preferred offer: Band II entry.
  2) Emma Torres — external, systems + comp-sci research; Bay Area; available immediately. Preferred offer: Band II entry.
  3) Priya N. (internal referral) — returning intern, strong product tooling exposure; Band I midpoint would suffice but prefers Band II.

Given the $38k remaining in CAMPUS-2028-RECRUIT, the $18.75k uplift is affordable and still leaves runway for other late-cycle hires. We can proceed with verbal offers for all three if Laura will provisionally release +3 HC today.

Attachments: candidate_shortlist.csv, band_uplift_proposal.xlsx, offer_template.pdf.

Neha
Campus Recruiter
Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Apr 2028 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: 2028 Summer intern pipeline — request for +HC and comp band uplift

Laura/Team — I reviewed the numbers and the candidate profiles. Operational note: two of these interns will be directly assigned to active sprint work (streaming cache + inference perf) with measurable deliverables; having those two onboarded by the first week of June materially reduces risk on a tight milestone.

Given the available budget and the reasoning from Neha/Vivek, I approve the release of +2 HC now (for Alex Zhao and Priya N.) at Band II entry for Alex and Band I midpoint for Priya. The third slot (Emma) is approved conditional on final P&L reconciliation — Neha, please hold Emma's verbal offer until Laura confirms final cost allocation.

If Laura confirms the CAMPUS-2028-RECRUIT code can absorb the $18,750 delta, consider this authorized and Neha should proceed to send the offer letters using the attached offer_template.pdf.

Aditya
Engineering Manager, Inference Runtime
Redwood Inference
